source_gap_claims.behavior: A detached positive Probe must successfully pass its valid independent input as part of the Probe oracle.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations require real-process execution and input/output binding, and reject infrastructure-failure or always-success false negatives, but none requires the positive Probe to pass its valid input.
source_gap_claims.subject: Detached positive Probe oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: A detached negative Probe must fail for its declared defect with the expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations require real-process execution and input/output binding, and reject infrastructure-failure or always-success false negatives, but none requires the negative Probe to produce the declared defect failure and expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.subject: Detached negative Probe oracle
